result.title: WorldStream: Streaming Interactive 3D Worlds with Hierarchical Planning and Persistent State
result.summary: We present WorldStream, an open-ended 3D world model with three simultaneous capabilities: it extends playable terrain beyond any pre-specified map, acts on open-ended language in the running world, and restores visited places with their edits. A hierarchical planner over a typed decision model emits structured decision state: Macro fixes settlement, ecology, transport, and hydrological structure across a group of tiles; Micro specializes that contract into tile semantics under measured terrain and accepted neighbor commitments. Deterministic local code compiles accepted plans into terrain, roads, settlements, vegetation, and entities. Streaming separates their reach: plans run ahead along the predicted corridor, compilation only where movement will soon need it, geometry behind the user released. One world record retains plans, seeds, object identities and mutable state, boundary commitments, and edits by attribute, revised as the user advances and edits; returning tiles recompile from it. The same record grounds interaction: the model acts on existing entities, including stateful NPCs that update as they act, edits the present region, or attaches intent to unplanned regions. Together they yield a world expanding under bounded budgets, connected across independently planned tiles, and interactive.

AI.brief_summary: 提出流式交互式 3D 世界模型：宏/微分层规划器产出结构化决策状态，再由确定性局部代码编译为地形与实体，并用统一世界记录持久保存计划、种子、对象身份、边界承诺和用户编辑以支持回访与交互。
AI.relevance_reason: 其宏/微决策契约、边界承诺与可修订的持久状态记录，可能为 LVR 中多尺度推理状态的表示与状态持久化、编辑一致性提供概念参照；但论文无视觉推理或 latent 表示分析，可供核查的迁移线索较远。
